results: Anonymous administrative and shared private APIs are denied
Admin assigns each position and login/session returns its actual identity
Product writes, prices, stock and administrative modules follow the role matrix
Content updates only content, including rejection of smuggled fields
Warehouse receives stock and cannot impersonate the recorded employee
Customer session and order ownership prevent shared API bypasses
Changing position and locking accounts affect already-issued tokens
Password reset revokes old sessions and allows login with the new password
